subject: [PATCH] mm/page_alloc: validate zonelist slots against concurrent rebuilds

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: Posted a follow-up reply to address additional race conditions pointed out by Sashiko, planning to repackage the patch with those fixes.

2026-10-16.patch_summary: The patch addresses a concurrency issue in the page allocation mechanism, where an allocation can succeed from a zone it never asked for due to concurrent rebuilds of zonelists. It introduces a new function `zonelist_zone_valid` that rechecks each zone against the highest zone index and nodemask before using it. This ensures that allocations are served from zones they requested, preventing unmovable pages in movable zones.
